title: mail-server: opt-in conditional (canonical crate)
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C7. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: L.

Canonical per-crate conversion per docs/design/conditional.md §5.1, §6, §7 (conditional-02 §3, §4.1, §4.2, §5.2, §6). Decision 1 (docs/design/DECISIONS.md): add pub register_mail_conditional<B: MailBackend + ConditionalBackend>(dispatcher, backend) that attaches SetSupport to each registered mail /set (Mailbox, Email, EmailSubmission, Identity, VacationResponse, and SieveScript when register_sieve_handlers was called), skipping unregistered ones; register_mail_handlers/register_sieve_handlers/register_mdn_handlers unchanged; works after register_mail_handlers_with_history too. Memory backend: Inner #[derive(Clone)], Arc<Mutex<Inner>> -> ScopedState (memory feature enables jmap-server/scoped-state), all async lock sites .lock().await, ConditionalBackend impl (begin_set via ScopedState::open; Atomic validate: Mailbox name+parent, role, parent cycle, SieveScript name and single active, overQuota/caps on final state); handlers skip cross-object pre-checks when cx.atomic; implicit onSuccessUpdateEmail runs inside the scope. Acceptance: example 5.2 integration test; one precondition, one atomic rollback, one final-state quota test; conditional_ready() true after register_mail_handlers + register_mail_conditional; all existing tests pass unchanged; crate README/PLAN document the opt-in; public-api additions only. This is the pattern C8/C9* copy.
